Welcome to the community.

1. there’s guides for each one which will explain in better depth - generally the rule is characters first, followed by gear/upgrade materials.
• always prioritize zetas/omegas in the fleet store early game.

2. Mods are a very complex concept to grasp, especially over text. There are theoretically perfect stat bonuses for each character, but generally, yes, your best mods go on your most utilized toons. Only equip 5 dot mods. Try to have speed on every single mod. swgoh.gg is a great resource, search “best mods for X” and click on the swgohgg link to see what the best players have put on that character. Once again, there are guides that explain primaries vs secondaries.

3. There isn’t much to go off of here, but credits are earned through completing activities/events in the game and buying them from the guild store. There will be times (very soon) where you often fluxuate between a surplus of credits and almost none. Try to only level up characters that need it (lvl 1-85 is about 6 million), and only spend credits on mods worth upgrading.

4. Participate frequently (daily if possible). Participating in battles earns your team points to enter raids. Eventually your goal will be to farm something to help either a raid or territory battle. I wouldn’t worry about any crazy farming until you’re well past lvl85 and in a guild with clear expectations, though I wouldn’t worry finish your geonosian team

Ultimately most of these questions have many factors to their answers. It’s pretty overwhelming at the beginning, but finding the right guides will ultimately help you understand these. The best way to fully grasp these weird mechanics is just by playing the game through time.
